name: Borde de Máscara Facial
algorithm: Face Mask Edge — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method specifically targets the face mask edge artifacts produced by face-swap deepfakes:

1. **Rostro Mask Región Estimación**: The likely face mask used in the deepfake generation is estimated by analyzing the spatial extent of generated content. Face-swap models use face detection to define a mask region (typically a convex hull of landmarks or Delaunay triangulation), then blend the synthesized face within this mask.

2. **Borde Artefacto Detección**: At the mask boundary, multiple artifact types are detected: (a) color seams where generated and original content don't color-match perfectly, (b) texture discontinuities from different rendering qualities, (c) double edges where mask feathering creates a visible transition zone, (d) compression artifact differences between generated and original regions.

3. **Feathering Análisis**: The mask edge feathering (smooth alpha transition) is characterized. The method measures feathering width, symmetry, and consistency. Deepfake feathering tends to be uniform width around the entire mask, while natural face boundaries have varying transition characteristics (sharp at hairline, gradual at jaw-neck junction).

4. **Mask Shape Characterization**: The inferred mask shape is analyzed. Common deepfake masks follow landmark-derived geometric shapes. The method detects unnaturally geometric or symmetric face boundaries inconsistent with natural facial contours. Specific deepfake architectures produce characteristic mask shapes that can be identified.

5. **Temporal Mask Borde Seguimiento**: The face mask edge position and artifact characteristics are tracked across frames. In well-executed deepfakes, the mask tracks face landmarks frame-by-frame, but the mask edge artifacts (color seams, texture mismatches) may vary in intensity — becoming more visible in challenging lighting or at extreme head poses. These temporal variations are quantified for scoring.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante face mask edge analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Nirkin, Y. et al. (2019). FSGAN: Subject Agnostic Face Swapping and Reenactment. ICCV.
